{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"Fine merino base layer: fitted, long-sleeved, hip length, warm ivory #f1e8da, thin merino wool, worn under the knit for warmth.

Refined knit: slim turtleneck, hip length, soft caramel #c8a27a, fine-gauge merino wool.

Trousers: high-waisted, straight leg, ankle length, deep charcoal #3a3d43, lined wool-blend suiting.

Textured jacket: single-breasted tailored blazer, hip length, chocolate brown #5a3d2e, herringbone wool tweed, cut roomy enough to wear over the knit.

Coat: single-breasted, just below the knee, with a wide collar that can be turned up, dark camel #8a6240, heavy wool-cashmere blend with a warm lining.

Boots: ankle boots with a low block heel and a deep-lugged rubber sole for grip on snow and ice, espresso #2b211b, waterproof-treated leather, wiped clean of road salt after the walk.

Socks: mid-calf, charcoal #4a4d52, thick merino wool.

Scarf: wide and long, wrapped twice at the neck, burgundy #6e2a35, soft wool.

Hat: close-fitting beanie that covers the ears, charcoal #3a3d43, ribbed wool with a fleece lining.

Gloves: wrist length, espresso #2b211b, leather with a wool or cashmere lining.

Bag: structured medium tote that holds documents and sits on the shoulder, dark brown #4a3226, grained leather that resists salt and snow splashes.

Why this outfit works: The business look stays neat, with a knit, tailored trousers and a textured jacket, while the layers of merino, wool and cashmere keep you warm through deep frost and a 20-minute walk. The coat and the jacket together mean you can take the coat off in the meeting and still look polished. The caramel, chocolate and burgundy tones are warm and rich against your dark hair, brown eyes and warm skin, so your face looks bright even on a grey snowy day. The lugged-sole waterproof boots, the ankle-length trousers that stay clear of slush and salt, and the lined gloves and hat make the commute practical without costing you professionalism."}],"usage":{"input_tokens":2423,"output_tokens":1444},"stop_reason":"end_turn"}
